Comm "Wally Session": Mitchell Billings has a session with Candice "Wally" Wallace
Comm "MITCHELL BILLINGS: How are you feeling today, "Wally"?": WALLY": Good. Weird. But good.
Comm "MITCHELL BILLINGS: It's gonna take time to adjust and find you role in this community.": WALLY": Oh, I've already got a job, and I'm not alone, I've got Fred.

Comm "MITCHELL BILLINGS: That's good. Is he your boyfriend?": WALLY": Oh god no. Fred? We're just friends. He couldn't handle this. Besides, I'm pretty sure he's still broken after the bullshit his ex put him through.
Comm "MITCHELL BILLINGS: Well, I'm glad to see you haven't lose your sense of humor.": WALLY": When you're not laughing you're crying and if you're crying, you're dying.
Comm "MITCHELL BILLINGS: You've been through a lot haven't you.": WALLY": You wouldn't believe it. No one ever believes the truth.
Comm "MITCHELL BILLINGS: You know, I find sometimes people surprise you, if you let them.": WALLY": That's hard, doc. To let people in, if you never let them in, they can never disappoint you.
Comm "MITCHELL BILLINGS: You know, sometimes people use their strength and humor as a shield.": WALLY": Or a weapon.
Comm "MITCHELL BILLINGS: Exactly, this is a safe place, you don't have to protect yourself anymore. You can put down the armor.": WALLY": Dammit, you're good, doc.
Comm "MITCHELL BILLINGS: Why did you join the True Sons?": WALLY": Shit. Guess we're diving deep today. It seemed like a good idea at the time.

Comm "MITCHELL BILLINGS: Even with what happened at Roosevelt Island?": WALLY": I didn't know fuck all about that. My job was keeping the lights on. You focus on the job, you can lose sight of a lot of fucked up shit.

Comm "MITCHELL BILLINGS: Do you think Ridgeway kept you in the dark on purpose?": WALLY": I think everyone does that. There's no way for anyone to know everything, so people only tell what you need to know to get the job done, that's leadership and chain of command. You follow orders and trust they are for a reason.

Comm "MITCHELL BILLINGS: In the end, you decided to stop following orders, what changed?": WALLY": We did. Ridgeway wanted to cut our losses. We all know about acceptable loss. We know about collateral damage, but Anderson, he was chasing danger. He was courting loss. He wasn't trying to stop the hemorrhaging. With Ridgeway, we were doing what we had to, to save the most people. With Anderson, he just wanted power, how else do you explain him partnering with Sokolova?

Comm "CAPTAIN LEWIS: Right? If they lead with this, we could have overthrown the Black Tusk.": WALLY": Hindsight. I'm glad you made it out.
Comm "CAPTAIN LEWIS: Me too. I wish more of us made it.": WALLY": Nope, stop. We can't go there. If we start crying we'll never stop.
Comm "MANNY ORTEGA: We're not public.": WALLY": Shit, Mari have you tried this ceviche?
Comm "MARI SINGH: Of course.": WALLY": You gotta have some.
Comm "MARI SINGH: I'm good.": WALLY": You're missing out.
Comm "MANNY ORTEGA: Okay, I think it's time for bed.": WALLY": I'll take care of our boy, go get your girl.
